title: Beyond Seeing: Fine-Grained Preference Validation and Severity-Aware Alignment for Mitigating Visual Hallucinations in Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.20478v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large vision-language models can produce fluent responses containing objects, attributes, or relations unsupported by the image. We study an implemented alignment pipeline that normalizes released fine-grained hallucination supervision, validates chosen-rejected preference pairs with vision-language judges, repairs rejected chosen responses, and trains LLaVA adapters with standard or severity-aware direct preference optimization. The study uses 16,143 normalized feedback records and 8,386 released preference pairs, comparing direct training with zero-shot and two-shot judged severity-margin variants. The zero-shot variant reduces Object HalBench CHAIRs from 53.00 to 36.00 and CHAIRi from 15.72 to 10.41. Across aligned models, AMBER-Hal decreases from 35.90 to 25.10-26.90, accompanied by reduced visual coverage. translated_title: 超越视觉：细粒度偏好验证与严重程度感知对齐方法用于缓解视觉-语言模型中的视觉幻觉
translated_abstract: 大型视觉-语言模型可能生成流畅但包含图像中不支持的物体、属性或关系的回复。我们研究了一个已实现的对齐流水线，该流水线对已发布的细粒度幻觉监督数据进行规范化，使用视觉-语言评判器验证“选中-拒绝”偏好对，修复被拒绝的选中回复，并使用标准或严重程度感知的直接偏好优化方法训练LLaVA适配器。该研究使用了16,143条规范化反馈记录和8,386个已发布的偏好对，将直接训练与零样本和双样本评判的严重程度边际变体进行比较。零样本变体将Object HalBench的CHAIRs从53.00降至36.00，CHAIRi从15.72降至10.41。在对齐后的各模型中，AMBER-Hal从35.90降至25.10-26.90，但同时视觉覆盖率有所下降。相比之下，基础模型保持了最高的有效POPE对抗F1分数（84.18，而对齐后为83.87-83.91）。
tldr: 本文提出一个包含细粒度幻觉监督规范化、偏好对验证与严重程度感知直接偏好优化的对齐流水线，显著缓解了视觉-语言模型的视觉幻觉（如CHAIRs从53.00降至36.00），但伴随视觉覆盖率和POPE对抗性能的轻微下降。
en_tdlr: This study presents an alignment pipeline that normalizes fine-grained hallucination supervision, validates preference pairs, and applies severity-aware direct preference optimization, substantially mitigating visual hallucinations in vision-language models (e.g., reducing CHAIRs from 53.00 to 36.00) at the cost of slight decreases in visual coverage and POPE adversarial performance.
